# Temple Scroll Column 46 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Temple Scroll Column 46 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 46:1 — "binding obligation" vs. "binding obligation" vs. "binding pledge" — issar rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "binding obligation" | Technical term for issar |
| LOGOS | "binding obligation" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "binding pledge" | Accessible synonym |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "binding obligation" per EMET and LOGOS majority. Issar is a specific legal term.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 46:4 — "restrains her" vs. "overrules her" vs. "forbids her" — heni rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "her father restrains her" | Literal — holds back |
| LOGOS | "her father overrules her" | Legal authority emphasis |
| PNEUMA | "her father forbids her" | Direct prohibition language |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "restrains" per EMET. The Hebrew heni implies preventing or holding back, not merely overruling.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 46:5 — "forgive" vs. "pardon" vs. "release her from obligation" — salach rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the LORD will forgive her" | Standard salach rendering |
| LOGOS | "the LORD will pardon her" | Formal legal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "the LORD will release her from obligation" | Interpretive expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "forgive" per EMET. Consistent with project rendering of salach throughout.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 46:12 — "utterly annuls" vs. "categorically annuls" vs. "completely cancels" — hefer heyfer rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "utterly annuls" | Infinitive absolute emphasis |
| LOGOS | "categorically annuls" | Formal emphasis |
| PNEUMA | "completely cancels" | Modern expression |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "utterly annuls" per EMET. The infinitive absolute construction is best rendered with "utterly."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 46:14 — "afflict the soul" vs. "self-denial" vs. "self-denial" — innuy nefesh rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "to afflict the soul" | Literal innuy nefesh |
| LOGOS | "involving self-denial" | Interpretive rendering |
| PNEUMA | "involves self-denial" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "to afflict the soul" per EMET. Consistent with project convention (cf. Leviticus rulings: ve-innitem rendered literally).

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 46:15 — "confirms" vs. "ratifies" vs. "upheld" — qum rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "confirms" | Standard qum rendering |
| LOGOS | "ratifies" | Formal legal term |
| PNEUMA | "upheld" | Past tense dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "confirms" per EMET. Simple and accurate for qum in this legal context.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 46:16 — "bear her iniquity" vs. "bear her guilt" vs. "takes on her guilt" — nasa avon rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he shall bear her iniquity" | Literal nasa avon |
| LOGOS | "he shall bear her guilt" | Interprets avon as guilt |
| PNEUMA | "he takes on her guilt himself" | Dynamic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "bear her iniquity" per EMET. "Iniquity" for avon is the project standard.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---
